answer: An oasis identity is valid only when a zk-SNARK proves that staking collateral is locked in a vault and that a sequential willow VDF output was computed for the epoch delay T, making forged identities incur non-parallelizable time rather than cheap proof duplication. If an attacker spins up bots, each fake credential must re-solve the VDF, so stake slashing penalties exceed captured rewards, producing negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium in which honest verification dominates.
